source_claim: Three distinct official routes were checked for bardiche_(device_form)_(nanoha) and bardiche_(riot_zanber_stinger)_(nanoha). The checked material did not safely establish those exact form identities as direct relations to the base Character.

checked_routes.result: The first-party original-series profile and story pages identify Bardiche and Sealing Form; the A's device pages identify Assault, Haken, Scythe, and Zanber relationships in companion AUTHORITY_BATCH proposals. They do not provide a safe exact map for the remaining Device Form or Riot Zanber Stinger tags.
The official new-series page identifies Bardiche and its present AX/Axe, CB, and standby states. It does not identify the exact Riot Zanber Stinger or legacy Device Form tags.
Good Smile's official figure page confirms Bardiche Assault's Bullova Form in the companion AUTHORITY_BATCH but does not map the remaining Device Form or Riot Zanber Stinger tags.

notes: Partial progress only. Preserve the base HOME and seven exact VARIANT_OF relations in the companion AUTHORITY_BATCH files. No negative relation or terminal outcome is asserted for the two residual tags.
